_comment: Official grouping for data/crawl/db/. Order and names follow the Royal Embassy of Cambodia in Berlin's list of ministries and institutions (recberlin.mfaic.gov.kh/en-us/ministries-and-institutions-of-cambodia), as supplied by the team on 2026-11-13. `matches` lists the names sources.json uses for the same body; `sources` pins individual sites that belong here regardless of their parentMinistry. A site that matches nothing here is filed under its own name after these 36.
